page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local NVMe SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation model ensures that each of the 24 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core without hyper-threading, eliminating resource contention from other tenants on the host.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c8i.6xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute resources relative to its memory footprint. This hardware profile is optimized for workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of hyper-threading, such as high-performance computing, batch processing, web serving, and compute-heavy application servers.
